# zstd / simple_compress

zstd's own fuzz target `simple_compress` ([source](source/simple_compress.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zstd (facebook/zstd at 82d322c4).

Checks one property, an API contract: ZSTD_compressCCtx into a random-size buffer in [0, compressBound]: any failure must be exactly ZSTD_error_dstSize_tooSmall.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zstd at commit 82d322c4.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- ZSTD_compressCCtx into a random-size buffer in [0, compressBound]: any failure must be exactly ZSTD_error_dstSize_tooSmall ([lines 49-52](source/simple_compress.c#L49-L52)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.
